items.exampleEn: There was a definite change in her mood after she heard the news.
items.exampleZh: 她聽到消息後，心情有了明顯的變化。

items.exampleEn: This cake was specially made for your birthday.
items.exampleZh: 這個蛋糕是特地為你的生日做的。

items.exampleEn: It's bound to rain this afternoon; look at those dark clouds.
items.exampleZh: 今天下午一定會下雨，你看那些烏雲。

items.exampleEn: He works irregular hours, so he often eats late.
items.exampleZh: 他的工作時間不固定，所以常常很晚才吃飯。

items.exampleEn: Will you be able to come tomorrow?
Excuse me, is this seat available?
items.exampleZh: 不好意思，這個座位可以坐嗎？
items.glossZh: 可用的；有空的；可取得的

items.exampleEn: The hotel is in a central location, close to everything.
items.exampleZh: 這家飯店位在市中心，到哪裡都很近。

items.exampleEn: We put the cookies in individual bags.
items.exampleZh: 我們把餅乾一個一個分開裝袋。

items.sentenceEn: The manager is not available right now, so please call back later.
items.sentenceZh: 經理現在沒空，請晚點再打來。

items.audioEn: I'm not able to join the trip on Saturday because I have to work.
items.audioZh: 我星期六不能參加旅行，因為我得上班。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼不能參加星期六的旅行？
options: Because the trip is on Sunday

items.sentenceEn: We don't have a definite date for the meeting yet.
items.sentenceZh: 我們還沒有確定的開會日期。

items.sentenceEn: Learning irregular verbs takes a lot of practice.
items.sentenceZh: 學不規則動詞需要大量練習。

items.stemEn: If you keep making the same mistake, you are ____ to fail.
items.stemZh: 如果你一直犯同樣的錯，一定會失敗。

items.stemEn: These shoes were ____ designed for older people.
items.stemZh: 這些鞋子是專門為年長者設計的。

items.passageEn: Our town's new sports center opened last month in a central area near the station. It is open to everyone, but it is specially designed for older people and children. Classes are available every day, and the hours are no longer irregular, as they were at the old center. Each visitor gets an individual plan from a coach. There is no definite price for next year yet, but it is bound to be cheap because the town pays most of the costs. My grandfather is now able to swim again!
items.passageZh: 我們鎮上新的運動中心上個月在車站附近的市中心區開幕。它對所有人開放，但特別為年長者和小孩設計。每天都有課可以上，時間也不再像舊中心那樣不固定。每位來的人都會拿到教練幫他訂的個人計畫。明年的價格還沒確定，但一定會很便宜，因為鎮公所負擔大部分的費用。我爺爺現在又能游泳了！

questions.questionZh: 新運動中心是特別為誰設計的？
為什麼明年的價格一定會很便宜？

items.promptZh: 這本書在網路上買得到。
referenceEn: The book is available on the internet.
rubricZh: available 表示「可取得的、買得到的」，放在 be 動詞後
「在網路上」可寫 online、on the internet 等
寫 You can buy this book online. 意思也正確

items.promptZh: 我妹妹兩歲時就能讀簡單的故事了。
referenceEn: My sister was able to read simple stories at the age of two.
My little sister was able to read simple stories when she was two.
rubricZh: 用 be able to＋原形動詞表示「能夠」（例如 was able to read；寫 could read 也正確）
「兩歲時」可寫，例如 at the age of two、when she was two 等
